headline: Worm-like SCKit malware spreads via ScreenConnect at MSPs; N-able 4EverAble2Shell zero-day; 4,800 GitHub accounts hijacked

bullets.text: New: worm-like SCKit malware is targeting MSPs through ScreenConnect, now the lead report in the MSPs story (7 outlets). ConnectWise is investigating breaches at nearly 50 organizations, and a ScreenConnect plugin flaw is being exploited to spread malware across hundreds of PCs.
New: hackers compromised 4,800 GitHub accounts to steal cloud credentials. This follows an attacker targeting 60,000 GitHub repositories in a credential theft campaign.

Still active: the N-able "4EverAble2Shell" zero-day was exploited within hours of a public PoC; no CVE or fix is on the board. New N-central exploits also work against patched servers, giving root RCE and Windows SYSTEM access.

Apache HTTP Server patched a critical HTTP/2 RCE, CVE-2026-119618 (4 outlets). The SignDrop Windows zero-day turns a CLFS security feature into SYSTEM access; no CVE or fix is on the board. Xen Orchestra critical flaws are exploited (3 outlets).

Also new: fake Zillow pages use ClickFix to install NetSupport RAT on apartment hunters. Still developing: Fireworks AI hack exposed Notion chat transcripts (7 outlets), Red Hat Quay flaw exposes private images, Apify token rotation, TSMC 46,000-employee leak.

KEV due 11-13: Barracuda CVE-2026-116606 and CVE-2026-111560 (exploited, 4 outlets) and Ivanti Connect Secure CVE-2026-104935. Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320, Outlook CVE-2026-124194 and Chromium CVE-2026-125350 are due 11-24. SITCON 3, 1.1x the 90-day average.

actions: ScreenConnect: inventory instances and plugins, remove unknown clients and plugins, and hunt for SCKit spreading from support sessions to client machines.
N-able / N-central: keep consoles off the internet, watch for a 4EverAble2Shell fix, and hunt for new admin accounts and unexpected agent commands.
GitHub: review org members' recent sign-ins, PATs and Actions secrets; rotate cloud credentials stored in repos or workflows.
Patch every Apache httpd instance for CVE-2026-119618 today; where you cannot, consider disabling HTTP/2 until patched.
Patch Barracuda ESG and Ivanti Connect Secure by 11-13; restrict Xen Orchestra to trusted networks.
Warn users about ClickFix pages that ask them to paste commands; hunt for unexpected NetSupport RAT installs and CLFS-based SYSTEM escalation.
